title: Driving & delivery
_note: English for work (english-for-work run, 2026-11-02): written by hand in British English, not yet checked by a second reader. translations.en = short definition in simple English; deHint = German translation (the 'German' tab). Words that already exist in the English lexicon are refs with a job-specific example.
intro: The words for work as a van, lorry or courier driver: your vehicle, driving, routes and deliveries, road safety and talking to customers and the office. Every word has an example sentence from a real working day in the UK.
introEasy: Do you drive a van or a lorry for work? Learn the words for your vehicle, your route and your deliveries here.
tipps: When you ring the office, give the facts first: “It's Amira, I'm on the A1, there's a long delay.” Then say what you need.
At a delivery, a friendly short line helps: “Morning! Parcel for you. Could you sign here, please?” People are usually in a hurry too.
If you cannot find a place, do not guess. Ring the customer: “Hello, I'm outside but I can't see number twelve. Where exactly are you?”
